brief: Workout supplements: pre-workout, creatine, protein. We compete on price, not on marketing. Same formulations as the expensive brands for half the cost.

profile.business_summary: An affordable workout supplement brand offering pre-workout, creatine, and protein formulations identical to expensive brands at half the cost.
stated_claims: We compete on price, not on marketing.
Same formulations as the expensive brands for half the cost.

relevant_tags.why: The core product category is workout supplements.

'balanced' bidding tries to win up to 60% of each host's page views; the planned bid per host is the price that wins its planned share.
